data.title: Dressing scissors
data.summary: Scissors · Straight scissors with one thick blunt blade and one sharp blade, for cutting dressings and sutures.
data.body:
![Dressing scissors](instruments/dressing-scissors.jpg)

_Also called: Straight scissors, Bandage scissors, Lister bandage scissors_

Straight scissors with one thick blunt blade and one sharp blade, for cutting dressings and sutures.

## Parts
- Two blades pivoting on a rivet/screw that acts as fulcrum; ring handles
- Lower blade thick and blunt (slides under the dressing, protects skin)
- Upper blade sharp - cuts as the scissors close

## Types / variants
- Straight dressing scissors
- Lister bandage scissors (angled)

## Uses / indications
- Cutting dressings and bandages without injuring skin
- Cutting sutures

## How to hold
Tripod grip: thumb and ring finger in the rings (only up to the distal phalanx), index finger resting near the screw joint for stability.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling
